title: Class-marked '(as a Warden)' options vary wildly in weight with no way to tell which from the label: 'take the reed-cuts on as your own watch (as a Warden)' at the eel-trader produced only a flavor line and no different bounty/outcome, while 'answer as a soldier of the old watch (as a Warden)' fully bypassed a fight/check with a drowned warden guaranteed. The tag doesn't signal how much the class actually changes the outcome.
where: Fenmarch / The Eel-Market — ask eel-trader; Fenmarch / The Flood-Watch — stair
